title: Feature-Fused Intrusion Detection: A Stacking Framework With Ensemble Classifiers, Deep Learning, and Autoencoder Anomaly Signals
description: Code, trained models and result data supporting the manuscript "Feature-fused intrusion detection: A stacking framework with ensemble classifiers, deep learning, and autoencoder anomaly signals" (submitted to PLOS ONE). The study uses the public CIC-IDS2017 dataset, which is not redistributed here; see docs/DATA.md for how to obtain it. The repository implements a stacking framework combining Random Forest, XGBoost, a deep neural network and a benign-traffic autoencoder, and includes PCA and component ablations, SHAP analysis, latency benchmarking, a repeated known/unseen attack-class evaluation, and the values behind the manuscript's tables and figures (results/metrics/README.md).
